Gain **400/475/575** Shield for **4** seconds. For the duration, allies within two hexes gain **15/25/60** Armor and Magic Resistance.

Meep Bonus: Meeps grant **125/160/210** Shield to the nearest @ModifiedNumMeeps@ allies for **4** seconds.

Gain **400/475/575 * 1%AP** Shield for **4** seconds. For the duration, allies within two hexes gain **15/25/60 * 1%AP** Armor and Magic Resistance.

Meep Bonus: Meeps grant **125/160/210 * 1%AP** Shield to the nearest @ModifiedNumMeeps@ allies for **4** seconds.

Pyke.ability_description: Reposition up to one hex to throw a harpoon at the furthest enemy. The harpoon pulls the first enemy hit one hex forward and deals **60/90/135** physical damage. Then, teleport behind them and cleave, dealing **210/315/720** physical damage to them and **120/180/360** physical damage to nearby enemies.

Rammus.ability_description:
Gain **675/825/2000** shield for **4** seconds. Then, strike enemies in a three hex line, dealing **50/75/700** magic damage.

Meep Bonus: Reduce the damage of incoming attacks by @ModifiedFlatDR@. After being attacked **20** times, deal @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ magic damage in a two hex radius.

Meep Bonus: Reduce the damage of incoming attacks by @ModifiedFlatDR@. After being attacked **20** times, deal @ModifiedPassiveDamage@ magic damage in a two hex radius.

Rek'Sai.ability_description: Heal **246/302/407**, then briefly knock up adjacent enemies and deal **80/120/180** magic damage.
Rek'Sai.ability_description_scaling: Heal **46/82/147 (Health scaling) + 200/220/260 * 1%AP**, then briefly knock up adjacent enemies and deal **80/120/180 * 1%AP** magic damage.

Rhaast.ability_description: Gain **20**% Durability for **2** seconds, healing **500/550/650** over the duration. Afterwards, slash forward in a line, dealing **120/180/300** physical damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for **1** second.

Riven.ability_description:
Passive: This Ability adapts to Attack Damage or Ability Power, whichever is higher. Attacks deal **75/115/300** magic**75/115/300** physical damage.

Active: Dash to a nearby hex, gaining **100/150/1200** Shield for **2** seconds and slashing adjacent enemies for **90/135/1000** magic**90/135/1000** physical damage. Every third cast, leap into the air and launch a wave of energy that deals **160/240/2000** magic**160/240/2000** physical damage to enemies in a line.

Samira.ability_description:
Passive: Whenever an enemy is knocked up, shoot them, dealing **65/95/155** physical damage and entering {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}} for **3** seconds.

Active: Unleash a volley of bullets at the target, dealing **375/560/900** physical damage and knocking up for **1** seconds.

Shen.ability_description:
Passive: On cast, attacks gain **38/63/819** stacking bonus magic damage. Starting from the third cast, gain true damage instead.

Active: Gain **395/601/4088** Shield for **3** seconds, then slice open a rift on the largest group of champions dealing the Passive's bonus damage to all enemies within. Enemies have their Attack Speed slowed by **50/50/99**% while allies within gain **80/80/999**% Attack Speed, both rapidly decaying over **3** seconds. Shen always gains his rift's full bonus for this duration.

Sona.ability_description:
Hurl a chunk of magnetic debris at the nearest target without one, dealing **300/450/999** magic damage and sticking it to them. If an enemy with debris dies, it passes to the nearest enemy without one.

Every **5** casts, instead rip off all debris dealing **120/180/999** magic damage, then crush all the debris onto the target, dealing **720/1100/9999** magic damage and briefly stunning them.

Passive: Once per combat after dropping below **35**% Health, gain Shield for **4** seconds equal to **40**% of healing received this combat.

Active: Heal **410/559/1858**, then tongue lash all enemies within two hexes dealing **71/107/1584** magic damage.

Teemo.ability_description:
Passive: Attacks deal **30/45/100** bonus magic damage and an additional **70/105/190** stacking magic damage over **6** seconds. While an enemy has **5** or more stacks, Teemo is in {{TFT17_SpaceGroove_TheGroove}}.

The Mighty Mech.ability_description: Enter a defensive stance for **4** seconds gaining **20/20/60**% Durability. While in the defensive stance, attract nearby enemy projectiles and heal **900/1300/3000** over the duration. When this ends, release a shockwave that deals **0** as physical damage in a **2**-hex range.

Twisted Fate.ability_description:
Draw a card with a value between 1 and 9 by Lucky chance, then throw it at the target. Based on the card drawn, deal between **205/305/460** and **410/610/920** magic damage. Overkill damage bounces to the nearest enemy.

3-Star Bonus: If a 9 is thrown, generate 1 gold.

Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

3-Star Bonus: If a 9 is thrown, generate 1 gold.

Lucky: Check twice and take the better outcome.

Urgot.ability_description:
Passive - Proximity Blast: Whenever an enemy enters a **0** hex radius, fire a blast in a cone towards the closest adjacent hex that deals **85/125/200** physical damage with **30**% falloff per hex. Each adjacent hex has a **5** second cooldown, and starts combat on cooldown.

Active: Gain **150/175/200** Shield for **3** seconds and reposition up to one hex to maximize the number of targets within Proximity Blast's radius. Reset Proximity Blast's cooldowns.

Passive: Every time Vex attacks, Shadow strikes a nearby enemy, dealing **27/40/250** magic damage. Whenever an enemy is struck **5** times by Shadow, Shadow strikes them again.
